propositions: When tool_step_limit is reached after a tool call has occurred, pydantic-ai omits toolConfig/tools from the next request while the message history contains toolUse blocks, causing Bedrock Converse and Anthropic to reject with ValidationException 400 (toolConfig required when toolUse history present)

The current empty-filter mechanism in build_agent_kwargs rewrites toolsets to hide tools at the convergence boundary, violating the provider protocol constraint that tools must remain advertised when toolUse blocks exist in history
Bounded recovery fallback (completion_recovery.py:471 with _EVIDENCE_TOOL_STEPS=16) dies with the same 400 error if an evidence run reaches step 17, blocking graceful fallback paths
Offline tests using FunctionModel miss the provider protocol constraint because FunctionModel accepts tools-less requests over tool_use history, whereas real providers reject this shape

The fix replaces empty-filtering with a WrapperToolset that steers tool execution (returns synthetic results) past the limit while keeping tool definitions advertised, preserving request validity and landing the run through the normal output path
